retained_path_clarification: Historical past-paths/tmp names are committed canonical repository paths, not live temporary directories.

hash_policy.task_and_small_inputs: Actual SHA256/byte count recomputed on every build.
hash_policy.retained_large_inputs: Actual source audit hashes; preserved Git object/pointer and current local size checked. Explicit rehash flag available.
hash_policy.document_limit: Documentation grids and native-coordinate preservation do not prove source positional accuracy or data admission.

exclusion_policy: Exclude self and final SECRET_SCAN/PERSISTENCE/POST_SCAN/POST_COMMIT/FINAL_SAVE evidence; root verifies their Git persistence separately to avoid circular evidence hashes.
persistence_verification: Run this builder with --require-persisted after root commits. This inventory alone is not a commit or remote-availability claim.

data_only_candidate_audit.behavior: Creation-only; rejects existing saved profile/audit. Recompute final quality through the preserved module with the saved profile; never delete saved outputs to rerun creation.

reproduction.execution_limit: Recipes read protected originals. Research output procedures may write only their separate task output paths; do not overwrite preserved outputs during reproduction.
